_comment: R17-A2 / AT-457 — deterministic offline fixture for the Confluence change-based ingestor. Spaces exercise the granted-only access rule (AC4): only spaces AgentIQ is granted (is_accessible) and not archived are read; an ungranted space and an archived space are excluded, and their content must never be emitted. Each content item carries the Confluence 'version.when' last-modified timestamp (and version.number) the connector uses as its change marker / opaque checkpoint position, ordered within each space so incremental (since-checkpoint) and resumable first-load batching can both be tested. Only page/blogpost types are ingested. The per-space cursor map in the checkpoint is keyed by space key. No body content is present — the reach phase reads metadata only.

HR.title: confidential HR space that must never be read

_bodies_comment: R18-A5 / AT-600 (T1) — page/blogpost BODY fixture for the deep-content path. Deliberately absent for HR/OLD (ungranted/archived) so a test can prove the depth path never needs, and never fetches, their content — the permission boundary holds all the way to depth (AC4). Storage-format HTML preserves heading structure (h1/h2/...) so the rendered text keeps ATX-style headings for the substrate's prose chunker to split on (AC1).
